rule_sets.py:239 creates lock via field(default_factory=asyncio.Lock); pyproject.toml:10 requires Python >=3.11. In 3.10+ asyncio.Lock inherits mixins._LoopBoundMixin: no loop is captured in __init__ (no get_event_loop call), and the loop is bound lazily via _get_loop() only when an acquire actually has to wait (contended). So construction at config load outside any running loop is fine, and rule_sets.py:540 `async with state.lock` works in the serving loop (uncontended acquire never binds; contended binds to the running serving loop). The only call site, query_database.py:674, runs inside the server's loop; serving uses a single loop (transport/http.py:249 uvicorn.run, server.py:983 mcp.run). The asyncio.run calls in cli.py:501 and 620 are separate commands, each a fresh loop; a RuntimeError would require the same CatalogConfirmation to be contended across two different loops, which no serve path does. Library source not read directly (stdlib semantics from knowledge), but the trace of the repo code is complete.
